items.title: Jackie Cain and Roy Kral interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: The interviewee does not speak about George Wein; the mention is made by the interviewer who states 'I talked to George Wein'.

ctx.x: Yeah. You know it was kind of funny because standing backstage when they said that Joe [Williams] wasn’t going to appear, because he was ill, and everybody went awww, and I thought oh gee, now we have to jump into his shoes. But then when we came out we got such a wonderful reception.

It was such a warm reception. And I talked to George Wein who was backstage, and I said, “George, it was so wonderful. We walked out, we hadn’t done anything, and yet we got this great reception.” He says, “well, we’ll have to do more of this.” So that was very nice.
You remind him of that occasionally.
